description:
FILED s530 (Fable), from the USER-asked review of the CPAN board's whole-file failures.
The board (tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl) calls a t-file FAIL when it produced no passing assertion -- including a file whose ONLY output is `1..0 # SKIP ...` and whose perl oracle SKIPS IT TOO (a missing optional module, an author test).  At s530 that is 69 of the 138 FAIL files (Template-Toolkit 17, Log-Log4perl 17, Text-Balanced 5, ...): the headline FAIL count is half "perl skips this as well".
Fix (runner-only): verdict SKIP when PCL's output is a skip_all plan AND perl's is too; its own column in the per-dist line and the totals; never in PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL.  The `*FILE*` PERL-SKIP rows in baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv stay as the record.
Bar: file totals before -> after on the same tree (FAIL ~138 -> ~69, SKIP ~69, nothing else moves); a tools/t row for the verdict.
QUEUED: s531b member 0 (`briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s530/s531b-prompt.md`).

=== ABSORBED (s530, Fable) ===
The SKIP verdict is item 4 of #4200, the verdict register (docs/test-verdict-register-proposal.md); s531b member 0 builds both.


=== DONE (s531b) ===
The SKIP verdict ships with #4200 (s531b member 4): tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl runs every t-file under real perl too (tools/run-dist-t.pl --oracle-only, cached) and reads SKIP iff PCL's output is `1..0 # SKIP` AND perl's is; PCL skipping a file perl runs stays FAIL.  Own column in the per-dist line and the new TOTAL line; never in PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL; the `*FILE*` row is still written for a SKIP file (so --diff reports it neither FIXED nor LOST); $grand_bad counts FAIL alone.  Guard rows in tools/t/cpan-scoreboard.t (SKIP with an oracle stub, PCL-skips-perl-runs reads FAIL, MISMATCH fires, --diff on a SKIP file).
BAR, same tree (s531b, main ade297e7 + tools): FAIL 133 -> 66, SKIP 67, PASS 558 / PARTIAL 205 unchanged.  Of the 69 PERL-SKIP rows, 67 are SKIP; the other two (IO-Compress 999pod.t, Text-CSV 00_pod.t) are files perl RUNS on this box now (Test::Pod 1.52 installed) and PCL cannot load Test::Pod -> FAIL, re-caused #4186.  (The 138 of s530 was the s530b tree; main's merges since moved five files out of FAIL.)
subject: The CPAN board calls a file perl ALSO SKIPS (`1..0 # SKIP`) a FAIL -- 69 of the 138 FAIL files at s530; add a SKIP verdict (tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl)
